source_snapshot.procedure: GET the Redfish active SMC inventory resource corresponding to `/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory/amc_active`.
source_snapshot.criteria: Active SMC firmware matches the approved GPU firmware/software release note.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES retrieves a broad inventory through sshpass, disabled host/TLS verification and hardcoded BMC credentials rather than the exact SMC resource.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Uses the correct inventory family but does not prove which response entry is active SMC and exposes management credentials/trust.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds exact resource/component uniqueness, TLS trust, least-privilege access, response redaction, release-note comparison and audit trail.
historical_reviews.related_cases: ROT and SMC-FPGA version rows use distinct component resources and must not be conflated with the SMC controller firmware.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Keeps the fixed HTTP address only as source context; execution requires secure endpoint substitution approved by the project.

original_test_intent: Confirm the active SMC firmware version on the intended GPU baseboard is uniquely retrieved and equals the release-approved value.
original_method: Use a TLS-verified BMC endpoint and brokered read-only role to query exact amc_active, retain a minimal redacted response/audit record, resolve the active SMC identity and compare version to the approved software/firmware bundle.
manual_activity: Engineering/security supplies trust, SMC component mapping and expected release; engineer resolves version/access anomalies and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: Verified BMC/Redfish address, certificate chain and network ACL
Expected active SMC version and signed/approved release note
Redaction, BMC audit and protected evidence policy
safety_requirements: Use least-privilege transient or brokered access
Limit request to inventory read and exact component
Stop on TLS/auth/duplicate/missing/malformed component or audit fault
Never record secrets or invoke update/reset operations
agent_execution_scope: Issue the approved exact TLS-verified GET
Retain allowed response metadata and redacted component JSON
Compare active SMC identity/version to supplied release baseline
Do not bypass trust, broaden to mutation endpoints or issue PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve endpoint, trust, access role and SMC schema mapping
Resolve mismatch/security problems and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A broad insecure inventory may return multiple controllers and cannot establish the precise amc_active version or trustworthy source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: GET exact `amc_active` through verified HTTPS with brokered read-only credentials and compare its unique active SMC version to the approved bundle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SMC active resource, release-note acceptance and source 5/5 timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a component-specific evidence row containing verified BMC identity, URI, SMC member ID, active status, version and expected bundle reference.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates insecure broad discovery while preserving the exact version check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: ROT or FPGA inventory cannot substitute for SMC controller firmware.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some implementations call the SMC resource AMC; the approved schema mapping must explicitly bind that naming.

project_override_considerations: Project authority may approve an equivalent secure SMC-native query if it uniquely maps to amc_active and the release bundle; no version update belongs to this case.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/Redfish identity, TLS result and service version
Exact amc_active URI/status/timestamp and redacted response
BMC audit/security observations and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, amc_active URI and Criteria consistently target active SMC firmware. AMC naming requires mapping but does not create competing coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Endpoint/trust/access/schema/version inputs can be supplied; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Narrows an insecure broad inventory into a trusted, component-specific SMC active-version comparison with schema and release traceability.
independent_technical_reasoning: A firmware inventory often includes multiple controller, active and recovery images. Matching any version-like string can yield a false pass. The evidence must connect the verified baseboard endpoint to the amc_active member, active state and approved release entry; transport identity and redaction protect that chain without changing firmware.
